legal_units.title: Special provision for computation of capital gains in case of Market Linked Debenture.
legal_units.text: "Market Linked Debenture" means a security, by whatever name called, which has an underlying principal component in the form of a debt security and where the returns are linked to market returns on other underlying securities or indices, and include any security classified or regulated as a market linked debenture by the Securities and Exchange Board of India;
